correctness_suites.fixed_bundle: rows_correctness_suite contains both operators and the selected timing shapes in one hashed input/reference pair
correctness_suites.correctness_scope: Baseline, candidate, and sanitizer run all 22 fixed cases, including the three timing shapes. Timing selects the three declared performance cases and reports one raw sample array per case.
correctness_suites.receipt_policy: One native correctness invocation per baseline/candidate aggregates the fixed cases. Keep the six controller roles distinct; do not create timing/profile/controller receipts for every width.

selected_performance_comparisons.baseline: one warp per row, four warps per CTA
selected_performance_comparisons.candidate: one CTA per row, four warps
selected_performance_comparisons.question: Does CTA cooperation repay cross-warp reduction cost when only one wide row is available?
selected_performance_comparisons.timing: Preallocated resident kernel invocation; record runtime L2.

selected_performance_comparisons.baseline: one warp per row, four rows per CTA
selected_performance_comparisons.candidate: one CTA per row, four warps
selected_performance_comparisons.question: Does CTA cooperation help this width when row-level parallelism is abundant?
selected_performance_comparisons.working_set: 8 MiB X plus 8 MiB Y per buffer; with two alternating buffers verify aggregate against the queried V100 L2 size.

selected_performance_comparisons.question: Does a vector candidate retain a measured benefit when row parallelism is abundant?
selected_performance_comparisons.working_set: 8 MiB X plus 8 MiB Y per buffer; with two alternating buffers verify the aggregate against runtime L2.

evidence_rules: Baseline and candidate must implement the same named operator on identical represented input and references.
Residual+bias normalization is a separate operator and can only be compared as fused full-path versus unfused producer/consumer path.
Use unprofiled paired timing. Do not infer occupancy, bank conflicts, transaction count, or traffic cause from timing alone.
Query current cudaDeviceProp.l2CacheSize; a capacity comparison is not proof of actual cache residency or HBM traffic.
Record registers, spills, and shared memory; profile only selected representative kernels through the repository NCU path.
One aggregate rows contract and six distinct controller roles cover the fixed bundle; do not create roles per case or width.
